title: Successor compatibility of normalized quotient unit sections
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W, an ordinary quotient tensor model M [def-trf-completion-unit-models], and a completed-E sheaf module K. Let eta_n be the section-normalized adjunction unit for scalarReductionExtension to level n [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. For every site object U and x in K(U), define q_n(x)=M.evaluation_n inverse applied to eta_n(x). Then the successor transition of M.tensor(K) takes q_(n+1)(x) to q_n(x), as an HEq of the restricted and native lower-level section carriers. This holds for every n including zero, with no flatness hypothesis.

source.place: 03CZ and lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (03D7); quotient sequence site preceding sites-cohomology.tex 0941.

proof.text: Take the quotient adjunction fixed by its sectionwise unit formula, and define its native unit section and its transport through M.evaluation.

The recorded ordinary quotient natural transformation equals the adjoint mate of the successive restriction comparison, by its uniqueness clause. The adjunction Hom equivalence followed by its inverse shows that this mate sends the upper unit to the lower unit.

Restriction of scalars and the comparison eqToIso are identity on underlying sections. Use the proved transport-section lemmas, conjugate the mate identity by M.evaluation, and apply M.transition. Cancel the evaluation isomorphisms to get the successor formula.

theorem quotientUnitSection_transition (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (K : scalarReductionSource l E W) (n : ℕ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : K.val.obj U) :
    HEq (((coefficientSequenceTransition l E W (Nat.le_succ n)).app
      (M.tensor.obj K)).val.app U (quotientUnitSection l E W M K (n + 1) U x))
      (quotientUnitSection l E W M K n U x)
